title: Pin the frozen latent-ceiling denominator before claims
finding: The preregistered experiment freezes a 1,383-item denominator, but the loader previously accepted any positive expected_total and evaluate treated that mutable value as the completeness target. A one-row measured corpus with expected_total=1 could therefore emit a numeric ceiling despite not being the frozen experiment.
primary_claim: The file-backed claim path now refuses any denominator other than the preregistered 1,383 items, and direct evaluation defensively withholds complete=true and a numeric ceiling when a Corpus carries a different denominator.
gardener_decision: Add one frozen denominator constant and reuse it at the existing load/evaluate boundaries. Do not add a configuration object, schema migration, corpus registry, validator framework, alternate evidence format, or retrieval backend.
acceptance: the committed prediction-only corpus remains valid, incomplete, and fixed at 1,383 expected items
a file-backed corpus with expected_total changed to 1 is refused before it can emit a ceiling
direct evaluation of a one-row measured Corpus with expected_total=1 remains incomplete and emits ceiling=null
the complete fixed-denominator fixture still exercises the >=20% decision boundary
the <=3% and 3-20% threshold regressions use the fixed 1,383-item denominator
no prediction or partial corpus can publish a numeric ceiling
no OwnerApproval, promotion, gate transition, or benchmark superiority claim is created
